rows.response_text:
To make potato cakes from mashed potatoes, follow these steps:

1. Cook potatoes in plenty of salted water until cooked through.
2. While the potatoes are cooking, gently fry onions until translucent and set aside.
3. In a large bowl, combine potatoes, eggs, pancetta, onions, butter, and chives.
4. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Adjust the texture with a bit of milk if necessary.
5. Preheat your oven to 400°F (190°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
6. Shape the potato mixture into 1/2-inch-thick patties.
7. Place the patties on the prepared baking sheet.
8. Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy on top.

Preheat your oven to 400°F (190°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

passage 2:Preheat oven to 425°. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Coat pan with cooking spray. Add green onions to pan, and cook 2 minutes or until tender, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Place mashed potatoes in a medium bowl. Stir in onions, cheese, salt, pepper, and bacon. Divide potato mixture into 6 equal portions, shaping each into a 1/2-inch-thick patty. Place panko in a shallow dish. Dredge patties in panko. Place patties on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray. Bake at 425° for 12 minutes.

Cover and cook until bottom is crispy, about 10 minutes; invert onto serving platter.
